1445-4871-6495-8347.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-6495-8347.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
1445-4871-6495-8347.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2105-3603-6791-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-3603-6791-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-3603-6791-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

728-789-2399--129.easyPrerequisites: Gutter Grime has slime counters on it at least equal to the toughness of the creature card in your hand.
728-789-2399--129.description:
Cast the creature card in your hand by paying {0}.
Either that creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, or activate Grimgrin by sacrificing that creature.
Gutter Grime triggers, putting a slime counter on it and creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Ooze.
When the Ooze dies, Colfenor triggers, returning the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
If the Grimgrin ability is not a mana ability, resolve those abilities now.
Repeat.
728-789-2399--129.notes: This combo also puts infinite slime counters on Gutter Grime, allowing you to easily create additional infinitely large creature tokens.

Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.

1978-7013-7714.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type, or at least two Robots or Villains.
1978-7013-7714.description:

When White Lotus Tile enters, Ultron triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of White Lotus Tile that is a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.
During your next turn, activate the White Lotus Tile token by tapping it, adding one mana of any color for each creature you control that shares a given creature type
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the White Lotus Tile token.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1619-4050-4605-5542-6145.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6145.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Passageway Seer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Passageway Seer enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Passageway Seer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Passageway Seer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Passageway Seer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Passageway Seer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6145.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.

Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Ghave's ability, targeting Cryptic Trilobite.

Repeat from step 2.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Umori.
Repeat.

Activate Aether Spellbomb's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.

Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a land creature.

When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
643-5310-5686-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.

Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control

Resolve the Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

2059-2440-4183-4720.description:

When the token Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Village Bell-Ringer trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Village Bell-Ringer, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.

914-1869-3719.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least eight artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1869-3719.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creaitng eight Treasure tokens.
Activate the eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{B}{B}.
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Inalla.
Resolve the Ruthless Technomancer trigger, causing you to sacrifice Dockside Extortionist and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Ruthless Technomancer with haste.
The token Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice the nontoken Ruthless Technomancer and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate the token Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating eight Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Activate the token Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning the nontoken Ruthless Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.
Once you have infinite Ruthless Technomancer tokens, if Inalla is on the battlefield, you may cast Inalla, if necessary, and then use the Ruthless Technomancer tokens to activate Inalla's ability infinitely to cause any number of players to lose infinite life.
